name: Eden
tagline: An experimental open-source emulator for the Nintendo Switch, built with performance and stability in mind.
description: Eden is an experimental open-source emulator for the Nintendo Switch, built with performance and stability in mind.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/eden:0.2.1@sha256:934072cb6050caeb9f2fd1b76ddfb9861e6d5065924836dd67641103e3bb1cac
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
